notes: Smallest tool-less round-trip pinning the terminal-text end signal for Muse: a run's own terminal:"completed" record maps to turn_done (parser.go parseRunTerminal), IsAgentDone()=true with no open tool call, no PendingWaitingCue from the declarative reply, classifier rule 2b fires working→ready. Session-birth shape (a possible transient proc-<PID> pre-session vs. a direct single birth) is not live-confirmed — session_birth is left UNPINNED to a session (matches whichever appears first, born ready, pi-pattern), while turn_start is also unpinned so the matcher picks the FIRST session to go working anywhere (which must be the real session — a pre-session never processes a turn), and every phase after turn_start pins via same_session_as so the arc cannot land on a stray pre-session. Overlaps intentionally with basic-turn — this cell pins the end-signal mechanism specifically. Final state = ready.

text: A session (real, or a transient proc-<PID> pre-session) appears in ready within 2s of launch
User prompt drives ready → working (binds the real session; a pre-session never goes working)
terminal:"completed" on the run closes the turn → turn_done → working → ready; state never entered waiting
PID bound to the real session via its .session.lock
Driver tears the tmux session down — process_exited on the real session
